text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
……フォドラの地では、もう農作物の
収穫の季節を迎えているのでしょうね。
text.official_en: Harvest season must be approaching in Fódlan.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえば、貴方はアドラステア暦と
ダグザ帝国の暦の違いに気付いていましたか？
text.official_en:
That brings to mind the difference between the
Adrestian and Dagdan calendars.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そう、この地の暦は１月から始まり、
１２月で１年が終わりますが――
text.official_en:
Had you noticed? The calendar of this land begins
with Janai and ends with Decim.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
フォドラでは４月にあたる大樹の節からはじまり、
３月にあたる孤月の節までの１年となります。
text.official_en:
Fódlan's year begins with the Great Tree Moon, or
Efraul, and ends with the Lone Moon—Maresh.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
アドラステア暦は恐らく、ダグザ暦と同じく、
古代で用いられていた暦を下敷きにしつつ、
text.official_en:
Both calendars no doubt had their origins in the
calendar used in antiquity.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
春分の翌月を年始の基準とするように
なったもののように推測されます。
text.official_en:
Yet somehow, they diverged. In Fódlan the month
after the spring equinox now begins the year.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
なぜこのような変化を持たせたかについては、
あくまで私の想像に過ぎませんが……
text.official_en: As to the origin of this change, I can only speculate.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
例えば、農作物などの、種まきの季節を
基準としている可能性もありますな。
text.official_en:
My supposition is that it could be based on the
season when seeds are sown.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
他に考えられる可能性は、収穫物を
税としたときの管理上の都合の良さとか……
text.official_en:
Given the importance of agriculture, it could be
administrative as well. Crops must be levied.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あるいは古代の暦そのものを利用することに
何らかの抵抗感があった……などでしょうか。
text.official_en:
Perhaps it is strictly cultural, and the old calendar
was deemed unsuitable for some reason.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この間の砂漠で改めて思ったんだけどさ、
人間って、本当にすごいよね。
text.official_en:
Humans really are amazing, aren't they? Since we
got back from the desert, it's been on my mind again.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だって、ジョカみたいな、街より大きな船を
たくさん空に飛ばしてたんだよね？
text.official_en:
Think about it. We launched ships like Nuwa, bigger
than cities, right up into the air!
text.real_en:
Think about it. We launched ships like Joka, bigger
than cities, right up into the air!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あたい、ちょっと見てみたかったな。
そんな光景。
text.official_en: I wish I could have seen it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そんなにすごかった文明も、
滅ぼされちゃったりもするんだね。
text.official_en:
But they got wiped out anyway, no matter how
incredible they were.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど、色んなことには原因があって、
そういうものを考えるのがきっと、大事なんだ。
text.official_en:
If we want to understand what's going on, we need
to think about stuff like this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……あたいも、やっぱり真面目に
勉強してみようかな。いろんなことを。
text.official_en:
It's time I started studying. I want to learn all kinds
of things.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
とっくの昔に別れたけど、
うちの元亭主は本当にろくでなしでね。
text.official_en:
It's been a long time now, but I do still think about
what a good-for-nothing my husband was.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
８年ほど前だったかに堪忍袋の緒が切れて、
家から叩きだして、それっきりさ。
text.official_en:
Eight years ago, I finally lost my patience with him
and kicked him out. That was that!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこからは、女手ひとつで
一人娘を育てようと頑張って来たけど、
text.official_en:
Since then, I've done the best I can to raise Mu on
my own.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……今にして思えば、あたしはあの子のことを
十分に構ってやれてなかったかもしれないね。
text.official_en:
Or so I say, but maybe I just haven't been there
for her.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
自分が必死にやってる事を
言い訳にしてただけなのかもしれないよ。
text.official_en:
I've been so focused on other things... Am I just using
that as a justification for being absent?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しばらく見かけなかったが、
その様子を見るに、どうやら無事なようだ。
text.official_en:
I haven't seen you in a good while. You appear
unharmed from the looks of it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……勘違いなどはしないことだ。
別に君の身を案じているわけではない。
text.official_en:
Don't misunderstand. I am not particularly
concerned with your well-being.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私の目の届く範囲にいるうちは、
君から目を離さないというだけのことだ。
text.official_en:
I'm only reiterating what I've said before—that I
am watching you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あ、あの……
ご無事そうで安心しました。
text.official_en: You're still unharmed. That is such a relief.

text.jp:
しばらく、ダグシオンを
離れていらっしゃったみたいでしたから。
text.official_en:
For some time, you were nowhere to be found. I...I
was so worried!

text.jp:
はい、これ。
あなたが次の戦いでも、勝利しますように。
text.official_en: Take this. It may help ensure your victory.
